encrypted documents expose the password form and render after password entry
short panes do not inherit a fixed minimum height

limits: No real model prompt or account used.
Universal plugin depends on CLI/OCR 0.5.2 platform packages. Native execution verified on macOS arm64; Linux/Windows are cross-built.
Conversion commits and standalone HTML preview output remain filesystem artifacts.
Native Windows/Linux, remote execution, full reverse proxy and all extensions were not exhaustively tested.

workspaceExecution.osSandbox: macOS Seatbelt denies all filesystem writes except /dev/null; applies to CLI and OCR child
workspaceExecution.wasiWalker: hdrw-wasi feature exercised on macOS, including four WASI extraction workers
workspaceExecution.finalConversionCommit: denied in read-only; WASM conversion succeeds in memory; no output created
workspaceExecution.testProfiles: Removed from isolated rc.5 Web/Desktop and alpha.3 Web profiles after verification; normal user profiles were not changed
workspaceExecution.diskSelection: --workspace disk or stdin JSON workspace=disk; neither mode falls back automatically
workspaceExecution.diskCleanup: verified on success and deadline cancellation, including parallel workers

tests: embedded WASM reads stdin and emits one JSON result
Unicode filename discovery and extension filtering
sticky bounded stdout without partial overflowing write

previewPolish.appearance: DSH palette, fonts and document language; changes preserve source and page
previewPolish.wordLayout: fits pane width and preserves unscaled reading position on resize; unavailable controls omitted
previewPolish.loading: filename, progress indicator, reduced-motion support and timeout
previewPolish.errors: localized message, expandable details and fresh-viewer retry
previewPolish.sourceSwitching: per-open request identity rejects late completions
previewPolish.passwordEntry: local forms are enabled while CSP form-action remains none; encrypted PDF opened with Enter
previewPolish.fullscreen: iframe permits fullscreen; keyboard open/exit tested in Chromium
previewPolish.threeDimensionalFraming: bounding sphere fits the narrower camera field of view; tested at 240×600 and in the actual Desktop pane
previewPolish.previewBuild: Shared frontend workspace source 0.3.2; runtime hash recorded in package report

checks: portrait and landscape camera fitting
resize preserves orbit and zoom
initial scale
double-click restores isometric view and fit

npmConsumer.typecheck: strict TypeScript with browser bundler resolution
